content: The test image shows soybean leaves with a white/silvery powdery coating on the upper leaf surface — strongly suggestive of Powdery Mildew. Let me confirm with reference images.

- **Powdery Mildew reference**: Matches perfectly — the upper-right and lower-right panels of the reference collage show identical silvery-white powdery fungal growth on the upper leaf surface, identical texture and distribution to the test image.

- **Downy Mildew**: Ruled out — shows yellowing patches and pinkish fuzzy growth, not a uniform white powdery coat.

- **Cercospora**: Ruled out — shows dark purple/bronze discoloration, not white powdery growth.

The distinctive white, powdery fungal growth on the upper leaf surface is the defining sign of Powdery Mildew and matches exactly.
